state.seed_assertion: You may be able to justify a decision not to carry out a DPIA if you are confident that the processing is nevertheless unlikely to result in a high risk, but you should document your reasons.

sentences.1: You may be able to justify a decision not to carry out a DPIA if you are confident that the processing is nevertheless unlikely to result in a high risk, but you should document your reasons.
sentences.2: You may be able to justify a decision not to carry out a DPIA if you are confident that the processing is nevertheless unlikely to result in a high risk, but you should document your reasons.
sentences.3: If you intend to rely on the exception for disproportionate effort, you must be able to justify this, and you must take other measures to protect people's rights.
sentences.4: If you intend to rely on the exception for disproportionate effort, you must be able to justify this, and you must take other measures to protect people's rights.
sentences.5: Systematic monitoring of the position/location of employees as well as of the content and of the metadata of employee communications, provided that it is fair and with the exception of logging files for security reasons, when the processing is limited to the absolutely necessary data and is specifically documented is a type of processing subject to DPIA requirement.
sentences.6: Systematic monitoring - provided that it is fair - of the position/location of employees as well as of the content and of the metadata of employee communications with the exception of logging files for security reasons provided that the processing is limited to the absolutely necessary data and is specifically documented.
sentences.7: You need to be confident that you can demonstrate that the nature, scope, context and purposes of the processing are all similar when relying on a previously completed substantially similar DPIA.
sentences.8: You need to be confident that you can demonstrate that the nature, scope, context and purposes of the processing are all similar.
sentences.9: in such cases the controller should justify and document the reasons for not carrying out a DPIA, and include/record the views of the data protection officer.
sentences.10: If a controller intends to rely on the exception for disproportionate effort in invisible processing, the controller must be able to justify this and must take other measures to protect people's rights, including publishing privacy information and carrying out a DPIA.
sentences.11: If you intend to rely on the exception for disproportionate effort, you must be able to justify this, and you must take other measures to protect people's rights.
sentences.12: If one decides not to carry out a DPIA, the reasons must be documented.
